grasp_torque_frame — DRIVE tactorque op

• 数据种类:image2d × image2d × scalar × scalar × scalar × scalar × scalar × scalar → table

• 调用: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.grasp_torque_frame(m_ref, m_cur, dark: 'float', pitch_px: 'float', r_px: 'float', pitch: 'float', G: 'float', nu: 'float', a: 'float | None' = None, window=None, coef: 'float | None' = None, P: 'float | None' = None, mu: 'float | None' = None, torsion_model: 'str' = 'partial_slip') -> 'dict'(要直接调用实现,import tactorque; tactorque.grasp_torque_frame(m_ref, m_cur, dark: 'float', pitch_px: 'float', r_px: 'float', pitch: 'float', G: 'float', nu: 'float', a: 'float | None' = None, window=None, coef: 'float | None' = None, P: 'float | None' = None, mu: 'float | None' = None, torsion_model: 'str' = 'partial_slip') -> 'dict';从台账取用则 opsdrive.get("grasp_torque_frame"))

用法

从图像 1 次完成：基准与当前的标记图像(tacslip.marker_image)→ tacslip.marker_track → 以 m 为单位的场 → torque_decompose。pitch_px、r_px = 标记网格间距与半径 [px]，pitch = m/px，window 为以 [px] 计的 (cx, cy, R)。每 1 个标记的面积 = (pitch_px·pitch)²，散度的邻域半径 = 1.5 个间距。P、mu、torsion_model 用于扭转的换算(torque_decompose，默认为 Hertz 接触的部分滑移，需要 P 与 mu；平头压头用 "no_slip")。返回 = torque_decompose 的表 + track(matched、n0、n1、p0、u [px])。Raises ValueError：跟踪对应少于 9 个(不足以求偶极子)，pitch ≤ 0，torque_decompose 的 ValueError。
